name: black-friday
about: Black Friday ads. Black backgrounds with red, white and yellow only. Red banner with white letters. Not Christmas-like.

style.banner: red with white letters, large enough to read on a phone at arm's length; the whole logo stays inside the frame
style.animated_story: once the animation starts it runs animation to animation; never cut back to the face
style.ending: the end promo overlay arrives the moment speaking stops; never a frozen still frame
style.price: prices come from the owner's latest message, never from an older version
